product.name: LootRush Crypto Platform
product.description: A crypto platform providing a single account to access, trade, and manage multiple cryptocurrencies globally with integrated bank payments and low fees.

product.name: LootRush Wallet
product.description: A browser-compatible wallet supporting MetaMask-compatible games, enabling users to rent gaming NFTs without KYC, credit card, or collateral requirements.

product.name: NFT Rental Service
product.description: A service enabling users to rent individual or subscription-based gaming NFTs across multiple game genres without collateral or credit card requirements.
